research:rsolar:desc: Improves the efficiency of all solar installations: +2.5% energy production per level, up to +50% at level 20. Applies to every planet and moon. Stacks with Photon Collectors.
research:rerz:desc: Deeper drill heads increase ore production by +2.5% per level, up to +50% at level 20. Applies to every planet and moon. Stacks with Plasma Drills.
research:rkristall:desc: Cleaner crystal lattices during mining increase crystal production by +2.5% per level, up to +50% at level 20. Applies to every planet and moon. Stacks with Nano-cut Crystals.
research:rdeuterium:desc: Cryogenic extraction increases deuterium production by +2.5% per level, up to +50% at level 20. Applies to every planet and moon. Stacks with Isotope Enrichment.
research:rsolar2:desc: The second energy research branch increases energy production by +2% per level, up to +40% at level 20. Stacks multiplicatively with Improved Solar Cells: both at level 20 provide ×2.1 energy production.
research:rerz2:desc: The second ore research branch increases ore production by +2% per level, up to +40% at level 20. Stacks multiplicatively with Deep Drills: both at level 20 provide ×2.1 ore production.
research:rantimaterie:desc: More stable magnetic traps increase antimatter production by +2.5% per level, up to +50% at level 20. Applies to every planet and moon. Stacks with Vacuum Fluctuation Compression.
research:rlager:desc: Reinforced containers increase maximum storage for every resource by +3% per level, up to +60% at level 20. Stacks with Modular Bulk Storage.
research:rlager2:desc: The second storage research branch increases maximum storage for every resource by +2.5% per level, up to +50% at level 20. Stacks with Reinforced Cargo Containers.
research:rfusion:desc: Shortens mission duration. Level 1 unlocks the scout ship and research ship.
research:rkampf:desc: Increases attack points. Level 1 unlocks carriers, cruisers, guardians and destroyers.
research:rkristall2:desc: The second crystal research branch increases crystal production by +2% per level, up to +40% at level 20. Stacks multiplicatively with Crystal Lattice Optimization: both at level 20 provide ×2.1 crystal production.
research:rdeuterium2:desc: The second deuterium research branch increases deuterium production by +2% per level, up to +40% at level 20. Stacks multiplicatively with Cryogenic Extraction: both at level 20 provide ×2.1 deuterium production.
research:rantimaterie2:desc: The second antimatter research branch increases antimatter production by +2% per level, up to +40% at level 20. Stacks multiplicatively with Quantum Stabilization: both at level 20 provide ×2.1 antimatter production.
research:rleere:desc: Endgame research unlocks Void content: NPCs, orbital levels 4-5 and Void fighters. Also increases antimatter production.
research:rmondstabil:desc: Reduces the chance that an enemy moon destroyer will destroy one of your moons.
research:rbauplan:desc: Optimized construction plans reduce the cost of ALL buildings by 1.5% per level, up to −30% at level 20. Applies to buildings on every planet and moon. Ship and research costs are unaffected.
research:rmodultechnik:desc: Increases the effects of all equipped modules by +2% per level, both locally and empire-wide: up to +30% at level 15. Applies to every module type except PvP raid protection.
research:rmodulslots:desc: Adds a fifth module slot at every location. You still unlock the individual slots separately with command points.
research:rnanotech:desc: Unlocks the Nano-alloy Factory. Its first Tier-2 resource, nano-alloys, continuously consumes ore, crystals and energy.
research:rquantenphysik:desc: Unlocks the Quantum Chip Factory. Its second Tier-2 resource, quantum chips, continuously consumes crystals, deuterium and energy.
research:rhochenergie:desc: Unlocks the Crystal Laboratory and High-energy Shield Dome. The third Tier-2 resource, high-energy crystals, continuously consumes crystals, energy and antimatter.
research:rfusionskerne:desc: Unlocks the Fusion Forge and Fusion Bastion. The fourth Tier-2 resource, fusion cores, is the first multi-stage chain and continuously consumes deuterium, antimatter and nano-alloys.
research:rkitech:desc: Unlocks the AI Laboratory and AI Defense Core. The fifth Tier-2 resource, AI cores, is the only chain with TWO Tier-2 ingredients and continuously consumes quantum chips, nano-alloys and antimatter.
research:rmetamaterial:desc: Unlocks the Metamaterial Weaving Mill, Metamaterial Armor Wall and Gravity Stabilizer. The sixth Tier-2 resource, metamaterial fabric, continuously consumes high-energy crystals, fusion cores and crystals.
research:rsingularitaet:desc: Unlocks the Singularity Reactor and Singularity Turret, which produce the seventh Tier-2 resource, singularity cores. Required for the four eternal research branches, nine deep ships, the Abyss and the Mythic Module Forge.
research:rhohlraum:desc: Unlocks the Vacuum Lattice Mill and the eighth refined resource, vacuum lattices: stabilized vacuum made from metamaterial fabric, high-energy crystals and crystals. Building the mill also costs protomatter, found only on asteroids.
research:rkausalanker:desc: Unlocks the Causal Anchor Works and the ninth refined resource, causal anchors, made from singularity cores, AI cores and antimatter. Construction also costs protomatter. Causal anchors and vacuum lattices together are required to build the Causality Breaker.
research:rraffinerieoptimierung:desc: Increases the throughput of ALL Tier-2 factories by +3% per level, up to +30%.
research:rpanzer:desc: Increases defense. Level 1 unlocks the Shield Generator, Ion Shield, Plasma Thrower and Missile Silo.
research:rschildmatrix:desc: Advanced defense research. Level 1 unlocks the Gauss Cannon, Railgun Battery, Void Barrier and Defense Bunker.
research:rkampf2:desc: Advanced attack research. Level 1 unlocks bombers and battleships.
research:rfruehwarnung:desc: Forward sensor buoys reduce the chance of a raid being scheduled against you by 2.5% per level, up to −50% at level 20. Reduces raid frequency, not the strength of incoming raids.
research:rscanner:desc: Makes incoming raids visible in advance: +90s warning per level. Without this research, raids remain completely invisible until impact.
research:rnotfall:desc: Practiced warehouse evacuation reduces resource losses from a LOST raid by 2% per level, up to −40% at level 20. Only applies when you lose; successfully repelled raids already cost no resources.
research:rspyshield:desc: Obscures your fleet data from enemy scouts: ±8% inaccuracy per level on every scoutable value. Also provides a 6% detection chance per level, capped at 60%. Detected scouts receive inflated defense values. Level 1 unlocks the spy cruiser.
research:rdiplomatie:desc: Increases the peace dividend from active non-aggression pacts. An independent research branch, separate from the rest of the technology chain.
research:rdiplokreis:desc: Increases the number of pacts counted towards the peace dividend. The default is 2; each level adds another, up to 4 at level 2. An independent research branch, separate from the rest of the technology chain.
research:rdiplomatie2:desc: Further increases the peace dividend, like Diplomacy, AND increases reputation gains with every faction by 1% per level. The endgame continuation of the previously independent diplomacy branch.
research:rkolonisation:desc: Increases your colony limit. You always have 1 colony slot; from level 2, every 2 levels adds another. At the maximum level of 28, you have 15 locations. Colonization costs increase by +50% for each existing colony.
research:rflottenkoord:desc: Increases fleet dispatch capacity. You always have 2 occupied fleet slots; each level adds another, up to 10 at level 8. The Parallel Command skill can add an eleventh. Attacks, exploration, expeditions, colonization, espionage and recycler groups sent to foreign debris fields use slots. Transfers between your own planets also count, but a fleet sent together uses only ONE slot, regardless of its mix of ship types.
research:rminentechnik:desc: Unlocks the Mining Ship, mining missions and Processing Plant. Fly to asteroid deposits in the sector, mine them and bring the cargo home. Resources are credited only when the fleet returns.
research:rfoerderung:desc: +4% mining rate and +4% Mining Ship cargo capacity per level, up to +40% each. Both increase together: a trip takes the same mining time but returns with more cargo.
research:rtiefenbohrung:desc: Reduces a load's mining time by 6 minutes per level, up to 30 minutes. Cargo stays the same: you return sooner, without carrying less. Mining never falls below half the minimum duration.
research:rschuerfrecht:desc: Allows deposits in the shared asteroid belt to be reserved. Each level adds +1 mining right to the starting 2, up to 5. Only the holder may mine a reserved deposit; a stationed escort can defend it. Multiplayer only.
research:rexpedition:desc: Better research-ship sensors increase the chance of rarer expedition finds per level: items, rare materials, fragments and modules. Pure resource loot is unaffected.
research:rexpslots:desc: Increases expedition capacity. You always have 1 expedition slot, independently of fleet dispatch capacity; each level adds another, up to 5 at level 4.
research:rfrachtlogistik:desc: Increases credit-route capacity. You always have 1 simultaneous credit route; each level adds another, up to 3 at level 2. An independent research branch, separate from the rest of the technology chain.
research:rroutenoptim:desc: +3% yield on all trade routes per level, up to +30% at level 10. An independent research branch, separate from the rest of the technology chain.
research:rewig_prod:desc: Eternal research without a maximum level increases total production at every location. Gains diminish with each level: about +13% at level 5, +22% at level 20 and +33% at level 100. Costs grow exponentially. The branch never ends, but its benefits taper off. Applies outside the capped bonus group.
research:rewig_bau:desc: Eternal research without a maximum level reduces building and ship construction time at every location. Gains diminish while costs grow exponentially. Together with other construction-time bonuses, the reduction remains capped at −50%.
research:rewig_def:desc: Eternal research without a maximum level increases defense points at every location. Gains diminish while costs grow exponentially. The branch never ends.
research:rewig_lager:desc: Eternal research without a maximum level increases storage for every resource. Gains diminish while costs grow exponentially. Particularly useful for long offline periods, since production is otherwise lost when storage fills.
modules:werft:desc: Reduces construction time at this location. Other construction bonuses, such as Shipyard Core, the Shipyard role and Overdrive, apply in addition.
modules:schild:desc: Reduces resource losses from a successful raid against this location. Raids by real players use the average Shield Module bonus across all your locations.
modules:lager:desc: Increases storage capacity at this location.
modules:abwehr:desc: Increases the defensive counterstrike: successfully repelling a raid destroys more enemy ships.
modules:forschung:desc: Reduces research time empire-wide. Contributions from all locations are added together.
modules:sonde:desc: Increases expedition yield empire-wide. Contributions from all locations are added together.
modules:expschutz:desc: Reduces the chance that expeditions from this location encounter hostile fleets, reducing losses of escorts and research ships. Encounter chance reduction is capped at −50%.
modules:handelsleitstand:desc: Increases the yield of all trade routes empire-wide. Contributions from all locations are added together.
modules:kommando:desc: Increases your commander's total experience gain empire-wide. Contributions from all locations are added together, speeding up levels and the production and skill-point gains they provide.
modules:siegesschmiede:desc: Every NPC victory triggers a production boost: +4% production of all resources for 10 minutes, increasing with rarity and level and summed across the empire. Another victory refreshes the boost; it does not stack. Player and alliance battles do not trigger it.
modules:kampfrausch:desc: Every NPC victory triggers a battle frenzy: +3% attack power for 10 minutes, increasing with rarity and level and summed empire-wide. Another victory refreshes the effect; it does not stack. Only NPC victories trigger it, but its attack bonus also applies in PvP, like other attack effects.
modules:siegesschirm:desc: Every NPC victory triggers a protective shield: +4% defense for 10 minutes, increasing with rarity and level and summed empire-wide. Another victory refreshes the shield; it does not stack. Player and alliance battles do not trigger it.
modules:drucktank:desc: Increases storage at this location, scaling with your Abyss depth record: the base value at depth 0, twice as much at depth 40 and four times as much from depth 120. A Pressure Tank found early therefore remains useful.
modules:echolotmast:desc: Extends the lifetime of newly received bearings empire-wide. Contributions from all locations are added together. Bearings normally expire after two hours. Only bearings received after equipping the module benefit; existing ones retain their original deadline.
modules:splitterofen:desc: Converts part of recovered salvage into additional module fragments. Each successful dive gives fragments equal to 30% of its salvage, summed empire-wide. You keep all the salvage itself; the furnace adds fragments without taking anything away.
modules:nullfeldanker:desc: Strengthens this location's defense only against NPC attacks from pirates, raiders or faction fleets, and only when you are outmatched. It has no effect at equal strength and reaches full effect when the attacker is twice as strong. It does not work against real players. Since its contribution depends on the attacker, it appears in the raid report rather than your standing defense total.
modules:taktschmiede:desc: Reduces Shipyard Mark refit time at this location, and only refits. Normal ship construction is unaffected; use the Shipyard Module for that. Fully upgraded, the forge saves a little over a third of refit time. Capped at −35%, summed empire-wide.
modules:krustenpresse:desc: Reduces the duration of a terraforming stage at this location. Fully upgraded, it saves about 18 hours across all ten stages. Capped at −30%. It only works where equipped, since each location has its own terraforming project.
modules:wrackleser:desc: Increases the yield your recyclers recover from debris fields empire-wide. Contributions from all locations are added together, capped at +45%. It does not increase the debris field itself, only what you recover from it.
modules:prisenwaage:desc: Increases the prize cargo recovered from a captured ship empire-wide, capped at +40%. It affects the proceeds only, not capture slots or boarding chance.
modules:leviathanherz:desc: UNIQUE from the Leviathan hunt. The world boss's still-beating heart powers production at this location. Its fixed +3% experience bonus applies empire-wide and is never rerolled. Drops exclusively with world-boss rewards: 4% base chance, up to another 10% based on damage share, plus +6% for the top damage dealer. Always Exotic with a fixed maximum roll of 110%.
modules:korsarenkrone:desc: UNIQUE from the end of the pirate chain. The final captain's treasure hoard, rebuilt as a command center, increases trade-route yield. Its fixed +3% fuel-saving bonus applies empire-wide and is never rerolled. A 15% drop chance on defeating the pirate final boss at chain level 10, in addition to its guaranteed module. Always Exotic with a fixed maximum roll of 110%.
modules:waechterauge:desc: UNIQUE from Abyss guardian depths. A petrified guardian's eye increases defense at this location. Its fixed +3% expedition-yield bonus applies empire-wide, is never rerolled and survives every workbench action. From depth 40, repeat guardian victories have a 7% drop chance in addition to the guaranteed module; the first victory still awards the relic. Always Exotic with a fixed maximum roll of 110%.
modules:kv_bergungslogik:desc: Production and sorting controls recovered from a defeated wreck convoy increase resource production at this location. Exclusive: only drops from a wreck convoy, never from ordinary loot pools, forging or the module exchange.
